Management’s earlier push to broaden its TAM-diluted performance and sharper strategic choices are now essential to restore relevance.
Q2 performance was in line, with consolidated revenue growth of 11.6% YoY (India +10.7%, volume +5.5%).
Margin pressure persisted (OPM at 17.7%, down 70bps YoY and 40bps below our estimate), translating into 7.5% EBITDA growth.
